_why: ORIENT1h (D134's ORIENT1g note; .claude/knowledge/twins.md): a decision's dated notes as the decisions digest finds and labels them, one table its two readers are held to row for row. tools/orient-index.mjs writes the digest, over doc-duplicates.mjs' fenced and isNoteLabel, and tools/orient-index.test.mjs holds it here; the service's DecisionNotes splits a decision into entries, and DecisionNotesTests holds it here. Each decision: its file's lines, joined by a newline, its heading first and a last empty line for the newline a file ends with; its entry, the lines of its own text before its first note, `<id>:<first>-<last>`; and each note as the digest's row, `<id>:<first>-<last> <label>`, lines from 1 and the blank lines at a part's end left out. Each label row: why, a line, and the label it opens, or null for none.
